events.title: Outlets at Castle Rock Tree Lighting Celebration — Free Holiday Drone Show
events.time: 4:00–7:00 PM MST; drone show follows the tree-lighting ceremony; exact drone launch time not published
events.location: Outlets at Castle Rock, 5050 Factory Shops Blvd., Castle Rock, CO 80108
events.cost: Free public admission; 2 adults + 3 children $0 total. Food/drinks and optional toy donation not included.
events.age: Open to the public, all ages; no residency or military status requirement stated; no advance ticket or registration requirement published.
events.description: Special one-evening public outdoor holiday drone formation show, plus Colorado's tallest Christmas-tree lighting, fire-department/marching-band escort and free live performances. Unlike ordinary shopping or a regular-price theater show, the timed illuminated-drone aerial display is a distinctive, nonroutine visual experience. Organizer confirms Nov 14, 2026, 4–7 PM and free public entry; individual drone flight time not given. For 2026 Colorado-resident friends, not the family's 2027–28 stay. Westminster-to-Castle-Rock city-to-city drive ~39–40 miles (80234 exact route unknown). Outdoor schedule may depend on weather.
